<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

In the supplied three-route process with two finite equal-weight event laws, a true one-third risk bound permits actual failure; no judge using only the mode/arrival projection correctly classifies that prior bound for every admitted realization of both laws.

Canonical source: [WisdomFallibleJudgment.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/WisdomFallibleJudgment.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Arrival fails exactly when the mode equals the selected route. Supplied event lists are [0,1,2] and [0,0,1,2], with equal weight per entry; duplicate modes denote distinct events, not duplicate observations.
- One third is a numerical specification. The endpoint judge receives only the mode/result projection, not the law or full history.

Inherited assured_route_iff connects counted failures with failed arrival. A probability interpretation still needs warranted event weights; ethical permission does not follow from the bound.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 actually checked five new application theorems, each using only propext; 59 inherited audits are separate, 64 overall with 44 empty / 20 standard. Frozen source and receipt are bound; no repository-wide acceptance.

A local application, not new probability theory. Ethical risk acceptance, probability learning and the complete wisdom root remain unproved; the event laws and process are supplied.

- The risk statement is true while the target realization fails; warranted false belief is not established. Endpoint insufficiency does not make outcomes irrelevant to updating.
